"'''Arrow Three'''" was a [[clone trooper pilot]] who served in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Arrow Squadron]]. Arrow Three [[Death/Legends|died]] during the [[Battle of Kothlis (Clone Wars)|Battle of Kothlis]],<ref name="Stealth" /> in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].<ref name="TERC" />
